name: Rainbows
overview: The Bible presents the rainbow as a divine sign of God's covenant with Noah and all living creatures, symbolizing His promise never to destroy the earth by flood again. God sets His bow in the cloud as an enduring token of this everlasting covenant, reminding both Himself and humanity of His faithfulness. Furthermore, the rainbow's appearance is associated with the glory of the Lord, as seen in Ezekiel's vision, underscoring its connection to God's presence and majesty.
